warnings: Door/window detail sheet with no tabular schedule; recorded as schedule rows, one per printed mark (precedent: house 124's door/window detail sheets).

น1 and ช1 are drawn as one wall panel across a 4.00 column bay: wall ผ1 0.80 + sill 0.10, window น1 1.15, lintel band 0.25, glass light ช1 0.60, then a mesh vent band up to ระดับหัวเสา (total 3.70; the vent band's 0.80 is not printed). The opening widths are not dimensioned separately — width_mm carries the printed bay 4.00 and is flagged.

ป1 is the roller door (ประตูเหล็กม้วน) 2.72 x 2.25 under the lintel B1; its section prints the lintel as 'ทับหลัง ค.ส.ล. ขนาด 0.20x0.40 ม. … เหล็ก 4-Ø12 มม ลูกโซ่ Ø 6 มม @0.20 ม.', consistent with the B1 detail on sheet 1. ช2 is the mesh vent above it up to R2 — no height printed.

The numbered callouts (1-7, 01-05) refer to the sheet's specification list (รายการประตู หน้าต่าง ช่องลม ช่องแสง วงกบเหล็ก), which was not transcribed in this op04 run, so leaf/frame materials are given only where the elevation itself prints them.
